interface_decision.semantic_role: the inherited group structure on a subgroup and nested-subgroup Lagrange
interface_decision.litex_form: template-scoped carrier/operations, one packaged Group object, and nested closure/divisibility theorems

proof_spine: A subgroup is nonempty because it contains the ambient identity.
Restrict the ambient multiplication, identity, and inverse to the subgroup carrier.
Package those operations as a Group and view A subset B as a subgroup of B.
Apply Lagrange inside B to obtain |A| divides |B|.

blocks.name: subgroup_group_laws

attempts.verifier_evidence: SS006A1 outer try committed the inherited group laws.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm subgroup_group_laws:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, H power_set(G):
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, H)
        =>:
            $group::group_laws(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>, \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>, \subgroup_one<G, group, H>, \subgroup_inv<G, group, H>)
    by def $group::group_laws(G, group.mul, group.one, group.inv)
    claim:
        ? forall x, y, z \subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>:
            \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(\subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, y), z) = \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(y, z))
        \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(\subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, y), z) = group.mul(group.mul(x, y), z) = group.mul(x, group.mul(y, z)) = \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(y, z))
    claim:
        ? forall x \subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>:
            \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(\subgroup_one<G, group, H>, x) = x
        \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(\subgroup_one<G, group, H>, x) = group.mul(group.one, x) = x
    claim:
        ? forall x \subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>:
            \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, \subgroup_one<G, group, H>) = x
        \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, \subgroup_one<G, group, H>) = group.mul(x, group.one) = x
    claim:
        ? forall x \subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>:
            \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, \subgroup_inv<G, group, H>(x)) = \subgroup_one<G, group, H>
        \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(x, \subgroup_inv<G, group, H>(x)) = group.mul(x, group.inv(x)) = group.one = \subgroup_one<G, group, H>
    claim:
        ? forall x \subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>:
            \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(\subgroup_inv<G, group, H>(x), x) = \subgroup_one<G, group, H>
        \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>(\subgroup_inv<G, group, H>(x), x) = group.mul(group.inv(x), x) = group.one = \subgroup_one<G, group, H>
    by def $group::group_laws(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, H>, \subgroup_mul<G, group, H>, \subgroup_one<G, group, H>, \subgroup_inv<G, group, H>)

blocks.name: nested_subgroup_closed

attempts.verifier_evidence: Outer try committed: well-definedness, proof verification, and environment update all succeeded.

blocks.accepted_litex:
thm nested_subgroup_closed:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, A, B power_set(G):
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, A)
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, B)
        A $subset B
        =>:
            $subgroup::is_subgroup(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>, \subgroup_group<G, group, B>, A)
    A $in power_set(B)
    \subgroup_carrier<G, group, B> = B
    A $in power_set(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>)
    \subgroup_group<G, group, B> = (\subgroup_mul<G, group, B>, \subgroup_one<G, group, B>, \subgroup_inv<G, group, B>)
    \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.mul = \subgroup_mul<G, group, B>
    \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.one = \subgroup_one<G, group, B>
    \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.inv = \subgroup_inv<G, group, B>
    \subgroup_one<G, group, B> = group.one
    group.one $in A
    \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.one $in A
    claim:
        ? forall x, y \subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>:
            x $in A
            y $in A
            =>:
                \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.mul(x, y) $in A
        \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.mul(x, y) = \subgroup_mul<G, group, B>(x, y) = group.mul(x, y)
        group.mul(x, y) $in A
    claim:
        ? forall x \subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>:
            x $in A
            =>:
                \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.inv(x) $in A
        \subgroup_group<G, group, B>.inv(x) = \subgroup_inv<G, group, B>(x) = group.inv(x)
        group.inv(x) $in A
    by def $subgroup::is_subgroup(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>, \subgroup_group<G, group, B>, A)

thm subgroup_order_divides_subgroup_order:
    ? forall G nonempty_set, group &group::Group<G>, A, B power_set(G):
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, A)
        $subgroup::is_subgroup(G, group, B)
        A $subset B
        $is_finite_set(A)
        $is_finite_set(B)
        =>:
            $group::divides(finite_set_size(A), finite_set_size(B))
    release thm nested_subgroup_closed(G, group, A, B)
    release thm lagrange::subgroup_order_divides_group_order(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>, \subgroup_group<G, group, B>, A)
    \subgroup_carrier<G, group, B> = B
    finite_set_size(\subgroup_carrier<G, group, B>) = finite_set_size(B)
